```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
path <- "../data/raw/"
ai_gpr <- read.csv(paste0(path, "ai_gpr_data_daily.csv"))
daaa <- read.csv(paste0(path, "DAAA.csv"))
dbaa <- read.csv(paste0(path, "DBAA.csv"))
dgs10 <- read.csv(paste0(path, "DGS10.csv"))
# djia <- read.csv(paste0(path, "DJIA.csv"))
usd_ind <- read.csv(paste0(path, "DTWEXBGS.csv"))
gold <- read.csv(paste0(path, "gold-price-history.csv"))
silver <- read.csv(paste0(path, "silver-price-history.csv")) %>%
  rename(silver_close_usd_per_troy_oz = close_usd_per_troy_oz)
sp500 <- read.csv(paste0(path, "SP500.csv")) %>%
  select(Date, Price) %>%
  rename(SP500 = Price)
t10yie <- read.csv(paste0(path, "T10YIE.csv"))
epu <- read.csv(paste0(path, "USEPUINDXD.csv"))
vix <- read.csv(paste0(path, "VIXCLS.csv"))
tbl <- read.csv(paste0(path, "WTB3MS.csv"))
```

```{r}
dataframes <- ls()[sapply(ls(), function(x) is.data.frame(get(x)))]

for (df_name in dataframes) {

  df <- get(df_name)
  date_cols <- names(df)[grepl("date", names(df), ignore.case = TRUE)]

  for (col_name in date_cols) {
    df[[col_name]] <- as.Date(parse_date_time(
      as.character(df[[col_name]]),
      orders = c("mdy", "dmy", "ymd")
    ))
  }

  assign(df_name, df)
}
```


```{r}
forecast_dataset <- gold %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  filter(wday(date, week_start = 1) <= 5) %>% # only keep trading days
  mutate(
    lag1 = lag(close_usd_per_troy_oz),
    lag5 = lag(close_usd_per_troy_oz, n = 5),
    lag20 = lag(close_usd_per_troy_oz, n = 20),
    ma5 = rollmean(close_usd_per_troy_oz, k = 5, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    ma20 = rollmean(close_usd_per_troy_oz, k = 20, fill = NA, align = "right")
  )
```

```{r}
for (df_name in dataframes) {

  if (df_name != "gold") {
    df <- get(df_name)
    date_cols <- names(df)[grepl("date", names(df), ignore.case = TRUE)]

    forecast_dataset <- forecast_dataset %>%
      left_join(df, by = c("date" = date_cols[1]))
  }
}
```

```{r}
forecast_dataset <- forecast_dataset %>%
  fill(WTB3MS, .direction = "down") %>%
  
  # create columns for calculated variables
  mutate(
    TMS = DGS10 - WTB3MS,
    DFY = DBAA - DAAA,
    gold_return = log(close_usd_per_troy_oz / lag1),
    RVOL_20 = sqrt(pi / 2) * sqrt(252) *
      rollapply(
        abs(gold_return),
        width = 20,
        FUN = mean,
        align = "right",
        fill = NA),
    RVOL_60 = sqrt(pi / 2) * sqrt(252) *
      rollapply(
        abs(gold_return),
        width = 60,
        FUN = mean,
        align = "right",
        fill = NA)
    # RVOL_252 = sqrt(pi / 2) * sqrt(252) *
    #   rollapply(
    #     abs(gold_return),
    #     width = 252,
    #     FUN = mean,
    #     align = "right",
    #     fill = NA)
    # missing: LTR, EP, DP, BM
  ) %>%
  
  filter(date >= "2015-01-01" & date <= "2025-12-31") # keep 10 years of data
```

```{r}
write.csv(forecast_dataset, "../data/forecast_dataset.csv")
```
